_note: FEAST SURGE — the timed buff (Worker B, 2026-10-10, Steve: 'Okay build carefully'). The old on-strike feastBurn trigger is retired; the feast now grants a buff window that decays at the next dawn. During the window, strikes AND ability resolutions read the feasted multiplier. The devotion arming (scholar.prog.feastSurge) is the gate — the buff only grants when armed. Every lever below is documented in docs/BALANCING.md and docs/PROGRESSION.md. Old numbers (35 resonance, 300 bank) were picked, not calibrated — these are calibrated against feast->fight sims (see docs).

buff.durationNote: The buff always expires at the next dawn boundary (untilDay = grant day + 1, untilPart = dawn). A dusk feast buys ~2 parts; a dawn feast buys the full day. The countdown line states parts remaining, honestly.
buff.qualityNote: Uplift is the quality lane. q2 (1.5) matches the retired feastBurn's base ×1.5 so the top end feels familiar; q0 (1.2) is a modest lift for a thin-but-real feast. The devotion surge multiplies on top (see below) — a legendary spread + a channeled wedding ring is MEANT to feel unfair for one evening.
buff.surgeNote: Fallback when prog.feastSurge is truthy-but-not-numeric (old saves, tests). Real arming carries the promised multiplier (1.5 base, ×1.5 chosen keepsake, ×2 wedding ring). Effective mult = qualityUplift × surge, rounded to 2dp, stated in the grant line.

feastMinimums.minFeastKcalNote: Matches hostFeast()'s existing floor (400 kcal × roster, min 1,500). Below this it's a meal, not a feast.
feastMinimums.minGuestsNote: A feast is communal. Fewer than this is dinner.
feastMinimums.note: EVENT-SIDE levers (Worker A's feast event enforces these; grantFeastBuff records served/guests but does not re-gate — double-gating would let the event celebrate a feast the buff then refuses). Kept here so both sides tune from one set of numbers.

marking.note: prog.feastSurgeUsed (Arc IV deed-gate requirement) marks ONLY when the buff is actually USED in combat — a player strike or an ability resolution while feasted and inCombat(). A feast that warms no blades marks nothing and spends no devotion (honesty, carried from the old burn's 'spent only by a real feastburn' fix).

refeast.note: DESIGN CALL (Worker B, 2026-10-10): re-feasting while feasted REFRESHES the window to the next dawn and takes the better quality — it never stacks (no double-feast ××). The devotion arming is consumed on first COMBAT USE, so a post-use re-feast is refused honestly until the keepsake is channeled again. Min-maxing welcome; only the true infinite exploit (stacking) is prevented.

twists._note: Per-ability feasted twists — the known ability, temporarily evolved (ability-evolution canon with a timer). ONLY where the fiction supports it; default is clean uplift. Keys are 'abilityId.actionId' (preferred) with fallback to 'abilityId'. Kinds are generic framework handlers in feastBuff.js — never hand-written per-ability mechanics.

field_medicine.line: The feast steadies your hands — the poultice takes hold half again as well. (+{bonus} HP, feasted.)

pocket_sand.throw_sand.line: Feast-grease on the grit — it sticks in their eyes. (Feasted Pocket Sand: blind +1 round.)

scream_cheese.scream.line: The scream has somewhere to come FROM now — it echoes in their skulls. (Feasted Scream: stun +1 round.)

war_cry.bellow.line: The bellow comes up from a full belly — they stay down longer. (Feasted War Cry: stun +1 round.)
